lines.en: Each step I take, the sculk grows an inch.
Wind passes through my shell. I'm not cold.
My legs are heavy, but they still lift.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草变幽匿。
lines.en: Where I walk, grass turns sculk.

lines.zh: 我肚子里有东西要孵出来。
lines.en: Something in my belly is about to hatch.
The smell of earth makes me want to brood.

lines.zh: 脚底的草都枯了，卵要孵了。
lines.en: The grass below died; the eggs are hatching.
Each step, my shell grows heavier.
Eggshell in every joint.
Which way is the nest?

lines.zh: 我踩过草皮，草就没了声音。
lines.en: Where I step, the turf goes silent.

lines.zh: 这条路上，卵壳到处都是。
lines.en: Eggshells litter this road.
I carry a clutch of eggs on my back.
The hatcher is full of writhing.

lines.zh: 三十点血，全用来孵东西。
lines.en: Thirty health, all spent on hatching.
The sun warms my shell for nothing.

lines.zh: 骨头里在响，是新兵种在长。
lines.en: Something rattles in my bones: a new breed.
What I hatch knows only me.
The eggs in my belly are kicking.
Inside the hatcher's shell, the wind died.
Something inside the shell is moving.
Guarding the eggs, I can stand forever.
I've seen your face inside my shell.
My brood would like your shadow.
Do not turn it off; when the light dies, I move.
The breath you exhale is warm.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿孵化器，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Hatcher. Remember.
Sculk eggs pulse on my back.
I only want my brood to see you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛，我想留给幼体。
lines.en: I'd like to save your eyes for the hatchlings.
The living always peer into nests.

lines.zh: 我这具壳，就是给幼虫住的。
lines.en: This shell of mine is a brood chamber.

lines.zh: 我早没感觉了，可壳还疼。
lines.en: I feel nothing, yet my shell aches.
The arm broke, but the eggs still hatch.
My shell cracked. The eggs will spill.
Another crack in my shell.
This armor won't take many hits.
Don't touch - the eggs under my shell fear light.
Don't touch the brood. I'm warning you.
My shell is thick; hit me more.
Something rattles in my shell - and my bones.
My brood has your scent now.
Rot - like the old broth inside my shell.

lines.zh: 这具壳里，装的不止我一个。
lines.en: There's more than me inside this shell.
I shouldn't crave it, but the brood is hungry.

lines.zh: 卵壳一裂，我就把口打开。
lines.en: The shell splits, and I open wide.
This shell of mine is for hatching.
The meat's still warm - perfect for the brood nest.

lines.zh: 饿，这个字我念了很多年。
lines.en: Hunger - I've spoken that word for years.
The smell of blood seeps through the soil.
Feed me once, and my brood knows you.
Gold glitters - my brood likes to watch it.
Careful - you'll crack the eggs in my belly.
Keep off - my shell is all sculk.
Was that bump my fault?
One bump and shell dust falls everywhere.
Four plates of armor, and a pick still hurts.
You bumped the eggs beneath my belly.
Stay away from my eggs.
My shell pulses in and out.
You bumped me; the eggs swayed.
You're too hot - my eggs can't take it.
Only the eggs move in my chest.
This shell only hatches vermin.
Then we'll stand side by side and wait for the eggs.

lines.zh: 戒指会从我的骨缝滑掉。
lines.en: A ring would slip through my bone gaps.
Next life, I'll hatch the eggs first.
Hold hands? My claws would fall off.
Don't say love. Say remember.
I want to come close, but I'd crush the eggs.
Come closer - just don't touch my eggs.
What I hatch aren't eggs but soldiers.
Put it down. It's for the hatchlings.

lines.zh: 幽匿里泡久了，还认得它。
lines.en: Steeped in sculk so long, and I know it.
I dug it out from under an eggshell.
I found this in the sculk.
Pick it up. Put it in the brood nest.
Found it - good bedding for the eggs.

lines.zh: 我的手指僵了，抓不住东西。
lines.en: My fingers stiffened; I can't grip.
Carry it to the sculk pit and bury it.
A bone? No - just a stick.
Something bright - bedding for the eggs.
Whoever steps into the nest first dies first.

lines.zh: 你的热气，我隔着土都闻到。
lines.en: I smell your warmth through the soil.
The hatcher opened — sorry for the wait.
Locked on. Can't take it back.

lines.zh: 三十点血，只为孵出下一批。
lines.en: Thirty health, only to hatch the next batch.
The smell of fresh meat - noted.
Fresh blood is my brood's favorite.

lines.zh: 我肚子里全是等着孵的东西。
lines.en: My belly is full of things waiting to hatch.

lines.zh: 这地方，活人埋得太多了。
lines.en: Too many living things are buried here.
Run - my brood enjoys a chase.
Your eyes are for the hatchlings.
Don't look back. The brood is awake.
Tonight the brood eats meat.
Living one, don't tread on my nest.
Your heartbeat sounds like knocking.
You crushed the sculk I spread.
Three nights I searched for you.
Your steps shake the soil.
Mycelium grows where I walk.
No lungs - perfect for a chase.

lines.zh: 我的卵囊在背上鼓起来。
lines.en: The egg sac swells on my back.
I walk slowly, but my brood runs fast.
A shadow presses on you; my brood follows.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草，都告诉我了。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on tells me everything.
Look back at me. Just once.
The farther you flee, the hungrier my brood.
What's in the shell is coming out.
Each step of mine leaves a damp patch.
Ahead lies the nest where I brood.

lines.zh: 再走两步，就进孵化室了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you're in the hatchery.
If my legs fail, my brood will chase.
Pant - my brood likes the sound.
I spread every patch of sculk here.
These nights chasing you, I haven't tired.
Don't rush - the brood wants a look at you.
There's no soil in the light. Nowhere to hide.
Run, and my brood goes hungry.
Sorry - the brood made me do it.
My hatch opens; it won't hold.
A shell cracks and my work begins.
You stepped back; my brood steps forward.
There are still a few growing in my shell.
Fall - my brood will look after you.
This armor is only good for ramming.
When I fall, my brood spills out.
A graze, a pity, one inch short.
See? The brood taught me that.
This shell of mine is full of larvae.
My shell is heavy. It lands hard enough.
Shell against bone - which is harder?
My shell is hardened sculk.
I have you this time, and I will not let go.
This claw lifts so slowly.

lines.zh: 我的手指，还是幽匿的颜色。
lines.en: My fingers are still the color of sculk.
Night's here - time for the eggs to wake.

lines.zh: 从祭坛边爬起来，站住脚。
lines.en: Up from beside the altar, steady on my feet.
How many rainy seasons did I sleep?
Too bright - the eggs will go blind.

lines.zh: 幽匿的味道，第一口就饿。
lines.en: One taste of sculk and I'm hungry.
The eggs stirred, so I woke.
This sculk recognizes me.

lines.zh: 我身上裂开的地方，会爬出东西。
lines.en: What crawls out comes from my cracks.
Save your light; do not strike a torch.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，壳还湿。
lines.en: Out of the soil, my shell still wet.
By the altar, the sculk grows again.
Who uncovered my soil?
The nest collapsed. Where do I go?

lines.zh: 幽匿也会烧着，有点意外。
lines.en: Sculk burns too — surprising.
I fell, and eggshells shattered everywhere.
Water fills my shell - the eggs will drown.
The blast scattered my brood.
The arrow struck the shell I was brooding.
Light has gotten into the eggs.
The sculk mat's eaten clean. I'm hungry.
Lightning struck and the eggs jumped.
My brood and I fall together.
